title: NOAA Severe Weather Alerts
description: Active US severe weather alerts from the National Weather Service (api.weather.gov). Filters to Extreme/Severe severity events that map to investable sectors: hurricanes/tropical storms → oil & reinsurance (USO, XLE, TRV, RE); tornadoes → reinsurance; blizzards/ice storms/extreme cold → natural gas demand spikes (UNG); excessive heat → utility demand (XLU); floods → agriculture/insurance (MOO, ADM); wildfires → utilities (PCG/EIX) & reinsurance; droughts → crop prices (CORN, WEAT, SOYB, DBA). Region tier flags whether a major state (TX/CA/FL/NY/IL/OH/GA/PA) is affected. Feeds the Global Macro Risk Brief alert group. Free NOAA NWS API, no auth required.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = [
    'alert_id', 'event_type', 'severity', 'urgency', 'certainty',
    'area_description', 'headline', 'sent_epoch', 'effective_epoch',
    'expires_epoch', 'sender_name', 'investable_sector',
    'economic_thesis', 'region_tier', '_epoch',
]

SECTOR_KEYWORDS = [
    {'needles': ['hurricane', 'tropical storm', 'typhoon'], 'sector': 'Insurance/Energy', 'thesis': 'Gulf/Atlantic refinery & reinsurance plays (TRV, RE, XLE, USO spike risk)'},
    {'needles': ['tornado'], 'sector': 'Insurance', 'thesis': 'Reinsurance catastrophe bonds (TRV, ALL, RE, RNR)'},
    {'needles': ['blizzard', 'ice storm', 'winter storm', 'extreme cold', 'wind chill'], 'sector': 'Energy', 'thesis': 'Natural gas demand spike (UNG, heating oil futures via proxy)'},
    {'needles': ['heat advisory', 'excessive heat'], 'sector': 'Utilities', 'thesis': 'Electricity demand spike (XLU, natgas peaker generators)'},
    {'needles': ['flood', 'flash flood'], 'sector': 'Agriculture/Insurance', 'thesis': 'Crop insurance + ag exposure (ADM, BG, MOO, CORN, WEAT)'},
    {'needles': ['fire weather', 'red flag'], 'sector': 'Insurance/Utilities', 'thesis': 'Wildfire season (PCG/EIX utility risk, reinsurers TRV/RE)'},
    {'needles': ['drought'], 'sector': 'Agriculture', 'thesis': 'Crop price squeeze (CORN, WEAT, SOYB, DBA ETF, MOO)'},
]

MAJOR_STATES = ['TX', 'CA', 'FL', 'NY', 'IL', 'OH', 'GA', 'PA', 'NC', 'MI', 'NJ', 'VA', 'WA', 'AZ', 'MA']

def classify_sector(event_lower):
    for ki in range(len(SECTOR_KEYWORDS)):
        entry = SECTOR_KEYWORDS[ki]
        needles = entry['needles']
        for ni in range(len(needles)):
            if needles[ni] in event_lower:
                return {'sector': entry['sector'], 'thesis': entry['thesis']}
    return {'sector': 'General', 'thesis': 'Regional economic disruption - monitor local equities'}

def parse_iso(val):
    if not val:
        return 0
    try:
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(str(val).replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        return int(dt.timestamp())
    except Exception:
        return 0

features = []
try:
    resp = requests.get(
        'https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active',
        headers={'User-Agent': 'speakesquery (macro-brief) ingestion', 'Accept': 'application/geo+json'},
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    payload = resp.json() or {}
    raw = payload.get('features', []) or []
    if isinstance(raw, list):
        features = raw
except Exception:
    features = []

rows = []
for fi in range(len(features)):
    feature = features[fi]
    if not isinstance(feature, dict):
        continue
    props = feature.get('properties') or {}
    if not isinstance(props, dict):
        continue
    severity = str(props.get('severity', '') or '').strip()
    if severity != 'Extreme' and severity != 'Severe':
        continue
    event = str(props.get('event', '') or '')
    event_lower = event.lower()
    match = classify_sector(event_lower)
    sector = match['sector']
    thesis = match['thesis']
    if sector == 'General':
        continue
    area = str(props.get('areaDesc', '') or '')[:300]
    area_upper = area.upper()
    region_tier = 'REGIONAL'
    for mi in range(len(MAJOR_STATES)):
        tag = ' ' + MAJOR_STATES[mi]
        if tag in area_upper or area_upper.endswith(MAJOR_STATES[mi]) or (MAJOR_STATES[mi] + ',') in area_upper or (MAJOR_STATES[mi] + ';') in area_upper:
            region_tier = 'MAJOR_STATE'
            break
    rows.append({
        'alert_id': str(feature.get('id', '') or ''),
        'event_type': event,
        'severity': severity,
        'urgency': str(props.get('urgency', '') or ''),
        'certainty': str(props.get('certainty', '') or ''),
        'area_description': area,
        'headline': str(props.get('headline', '') or '')[:300],
        'sent_epoch': parse_iso(props.get('sent')),
        'effective_epoch': parse_iso(props.get('effective')),
        'expires_epoch': parse_iso(props.get('expires')),
        'sender_name': str(props.get('senderName', '') or ''),
        'investable_sector': sector,
        'economic_thesis': thesis,
        'region_tier': region_tier,
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

if rows:
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['alert_id']).reset_index(drop=True)
    df = df.sort_values(['severity', 'effective_epoch'], ascending=[True, False]).reset_index(drop=True)
else:
    df = pd.DataFrame(columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
